summary.en: The blueprint arc: problem as review items, claim as a general arrangement, details a person stamps, machine checks, the whole drawing under an approval stamp, the release.
summary.zh: blueprint 的骨架：问题画成评审项，主张画成总体布置，人盖章的详图，机器检查，整张图上的批准章，最后发布。

fits: Systems with a plan a person signs and checks a machine runs: rollouts, backups, migrations, pipelines.
notFor: Single-feature films; stories without structure; films under 25 s (use an excerpt of 2–3 sheets).

intent.en: Argue like a drawing set: one sheet per idea, each a different kind of drawing, signed by a person, checked by machine, approved as a whole.
intent.zh: 像一套图纸那样论证：一张图一个意思、每张是不同类型的图，人签字、机器检查、整体批准。

content.en: A problem, a claim, 1–3 details (one a person's decision), 1–2 checks, a two-line claim, name and URL.
content.zh: 一个问题、一句主张、1–3 张详图（其一是人的决定）、1–2 项检查、两行主张、产品名与网址。

fits.zh: 有人签字的计划和机器执行的检查的系统：发布、备份、迁移、流水线。

notFor.zh: 单功能片；没有结构的故事；25 秒以下（用 2–3 张的节选）。

en: Two consecutive sheets must be different drawing types; Chinese sheets read longer, so a 43 s English film runs about 50 s in Chinese.
zh: 相邻两张图必须是不同类型；中文读得更久，英文 43 秒的片子中文约 50 秒。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead against the original template's scene order and lengths (card, Differs from upstream)
